R6D-bear-backcountry-0002.name: By Batchellor Creek
R6D-bear-backcountry-0002.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R6D-bear-backcountry-0002.parkWhat: pull off on Kumealon Ml (gravel road)

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2007 (19 years old), 40 m E: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
SW facing slope, 10 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Batchellor Creek 30 m E: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

plan: Drive: from District of Port Edward, about 43 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.88537, -130.00669, pull off on Kumealon Ml (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 33 km SE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 1,605 m, about 820 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 100 m W of the spot at 1 m (53.63941, -129.73013). Water: Batchellor Creek 130 m E (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-11, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-02, closures 2026-10-16.
R6D-bear-backcountry-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-11: about 221 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.01 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

R6D-grouse-atv-0003.name: 1.1 km S of Brodie Lake
R6D-grouse-atv-0003.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R6D-grouse-atv-0003.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Kumealon Ml); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
3 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
4 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 6 table (pages 50 and 51), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
